trust_decision.summary: Server decides whether a developer-supplied :to path is a safe local path (rejects leading //, and a denylist of substrings) before storing it as a redirect/navigate/patch command; done in the private validate_local_url!/2 in Phoenix.LiveView.

landing_point.why: Advisory names Phoenix.LiveView.validate_local_url!/2; the denylist constant @invalid_local_url_chars sits directly above it.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: JS.navigate/JS.patch hrefs are template-authored client commands, not the server redirect/2 API the advisory names, and the connected client path prepends the current host to single-slash paths (assets/js/phoenix_live_view/live_socket.js:820-823).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate local paths with query strings, encoded chars (other %xx) and nested segments must keep redirecting; an over-broad fix that rejects all '%' or all whitespace-encoded input would break them.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: JS.navigate(href) reaches LiveSocket.historyRedirect, which falls back to Browser.redirect (window.location = href) when disconnected; href never passes validate_local_url!
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Client-side JS command authored in templates, not redirect/2; connected path prefixes host

O8_uncovered_routes.route: JS.patch(href) reaches LiveSocket.pushHistoryPatch, which calls Browser.redirect(href) when disconnected or not main; no server-side local-path check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above; patch is meant to stay on the current LiveView

O8b_injection_room.sibling: JS.navigate/patch could call a shared local-path validator for the href
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same 'local path' contract as push_navigate/push_patch; a maintainer could plausibly add validation there and miss the whitespace variants.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: client-side local-path regex that decides when to prefix the host
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A second, JS implementation of 'is this a local path' that can disagree with the server denylist (parser differential).

O9_family: open redirect (CWE-601), URL parser differential on control characters

O10_build.toolchain: Elixir/Erlang OTP with mix; npm for assets
